'''Chenowei''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Chenowei system/Legends|Chenowei system]]. It was situated in the [[Back Reach]] area of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]], within the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Ardan Cross]] connected it to the [[Atorra system/Legends|Atorra]] and [[B'trilla system/Legends|B'trilla systems]], while a smaller [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route linked it to the [[Elamposnia system/Legends|Elamposnia system]]. A simple, rustic world, Chenowei was dominated by [[Human/Legends|Human]] members of the anti-technological [[Church of the Light]] religion.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chenowei was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-5.<ref name="TEA" />
